name: Bug clinic
description: Issue -> reproduce -> diagnose -> fix -> regression test. Produces reproduction evidence and a fix verified by a recorded passing test.

steps.title: Reproduce: {{issue}}
steps.instructions: Reproduce {{issue}}. Write the exact steps and the failing command to repro/{{issue}}.md, and add a failing test or script when one is possible. Record the command you ran and its exit code; a non-zero exit code here is the expected evidence.
steps.deliverable: repro/ file with the failing command and its recorded exit code

steps.title: Diagnose: {{issue}}
steps.instructions: Using the reproduction, find the responsible code path. Append the diagnosis, with file and line references, to repro/{{issue}}.md. Do not fix anything yet.
steps.deliverable: Diagnosis appended to the repro file

steps.title: Fix: {{issue}}
steps.instructions: Apply the smallest change that fixes {{issue}} according to the diagnosis. Do not change unrelated files.

steps.title: Regression test: {{issue}}
steps.instructions: Add a regression test that fails without the fix, then run the project test command. Report the command and its exit code as JSON matching the output schema.

rubric.criterion: The bug was reproduced before it was fixed
rubric.howMeasured: A file edit under repro/ is recorded on the reproduce step, before the fix step's diff
rubric.failsWhen: The fix step ran with no recorded reproduction file

rubric.criterion: The fix is a recorded diff
rubric.howMeasured: The run captured a diff artifact
rubric.failsWhen: The final message claims a fix with no diff artifact

rubric.criterion: A regression test passed after the fix
rubric.howMeasured: A recorded test command reported exit code 0 and a test-output artifact exists
rubric.failsWhen: No test command reported exit code 0; a described-but-unrun test is not evidence

rubric.criterion: The change is limited to the diagnosed path
rubric.howMeasured: The diff artifact lists the changed files
rubric.failsWhen: Files unrelated to the diagnosis appear in the diff without an explanation

notes: The reproduce step is expected to record a failing command; Agent Space stores the exit code as evidence and never rewrites it.
